Mid-swing on the hand-prop, the mechanic minifigure leaning his whole torso back off the arc, heels lifting off the green plate mosaic, while a brick chicken perched on the spinner watches with one printed eye cocked sideways.

Mid-dive clear of the catching propeller, the mechanic flat out over the stud-grass with both arms forward and his leather cap already cart-wheeling three tiles ahead, the moulded blade a single stud behind his boot soles.

Mid-pull on the chock rope with heels gouged deep into the turf plates, the crewman leaning back at a forty-five-degree tilt while a second minifigure behind him shouts with both yellow hands cupped around his printed mouth.

Mid-climb up the brick step-ladder with a spanner element raised high toward the open cowling ring, the red toolbox already tipping off the top rung and three loose spanner studs arcing outward across the apron tiles below.

Mid-pour from a tipped yellow fuel churn onto the top-wing filler, the fuel hand braced on one knee while a brick goose drives its orange beak hard into his boot and the ladder sways on the plate-grass.

Mid-wave with two plain paddle bats crossed high overhead, the flagman leaning so far back on his heels his torso is nearly parallel to the runway plates, a single daisy plant element pressed flat under one foot.

Mid-chase after a tan dog figure sprinting with the leather cap clamped in its printed jaws, the mechanic stretched full-length across the green plates with one yellow hand a single clip's width from the dog's wagging tail.

Mid-lift of a lime-green crate up into the front cockpit, both arms locked straight overhead and knees bent deep, while a small frog element rides the crate lid unnoticed, the jungle-strip backdrop a wall of dark-green palm plates.

Mid-handover of a jam jar element, the kid minifigure balanced on the top fence rail on one foot, arm fully extended upward, and a yellow hand reaching down from the cockpit rim to close its C-shaped grip around the lid.

Mid-shout up at the cockpit rim with both yellow hands cupped and one boot planted on the tyre element, the mechanic's torso tilted back, his printed face wide-eyed, a half-eaten orange slope-brick sandwich left forgotten on the step.

Mid-haul on the tail skid, one crewman planted wide with a second further round the skid and swinging the whole empennage around while a third minifigure with one arm raised calls the turn and a brick hen pecks at the rudder hinge bar.

Mid-untangle of a crewman caught in the bar-and-clip rigging, one arm hooked deep through the taut wire run and the other flailing for the strut bar, his printed face showing an expression of pure theatrical despair.

Mid-shoo of a brick chicken off the rocker cover with a rolled white rag element, the bird half-airborne with both wing plates flared wide, the mechanic's boot sliding off the trestle edge over a drop to the green apron tiles.

Mid-brush of dope onto a peeled lower-wing panel, the crewman kneeling on a trestle plank with a wide brush element sweeping left, a small open tin balanced on the forward spar while a curious snail plant-piece sits on the spar beside it.

Mid-scramble up onto the upper wing with a full bucket element, one boot slipping off the bar-strut and the other scrabbling at a plate edge, the bucket tilting and one trans-blue water slope already spilling over the leading-edge tiles.

Mid-crank of a brick box camera on a Technic-pin tripod, the photographer bent low with both yellow hands on the crank bar as the biplane rolls past, a brick squirrel perched on the camera top watching the propeller spin instead.

Mid-spill of the red toolbox down the ladder, the crewman above grabbing the rail with one hand while four spanner elements and a round-plate gear scatter across the bright-yellow apron tiles in a wide stud-bouncing arc below.

Mid-dash across the apron with a red extinguisher brick held straight out in both C-grip hands and one foot entirely off the tiles, the crewman's scarf element streaming back while a curl of white cloud-slope bricks lifts from the cowling.

Mid-toss of a rolled canvas bundle upward toward the cockpit rim, the crewman's arms at full extension and the bundle spinning end-over-end, while a second minifigure in the rear cockpit reaches out with both yellow hands to catch it.

Mid-squirt of an oil can at the exposed rocker gear, the mechanic's elbow braced hard on the cowl lip and his whole body leaning in, a tiny cactus plant element wedged inexplicably between the cylinder head bricks beside his hand.

Mid-signal from a marshaller dropped on one knee with a plain orange bat pointed flat at the tail skid, his free hand pressed to the tarmac tiles for balance, a single gold coin element glinting on the apron between his knees.

Mid-swap of a cracked propeller blade, the crewman pressing the bright-yellow replacement onto the hub pin with both palms flat, while the old broken blade leans against the wheel in two clean brick-snap halves on the plate-grass behind him.

Mid-push on the port wingtip, three crew leaning shoulder-first with feet splayed on the turf plates as the whole machine rolls backward, the wind-cone element on its pole snapping horizontal and a startled brick rabbit bolting from beneath the tail.

Mid-clamber of two kid minifigures up the wooden fence rails, one foot on the lowest bar and one on the top, while the taller kid still grips a small moulded toy biplane in one yellow hand and refuses to let go.

Mid-fold of a white parachute canopy across a long trestle, two crew each pulling an opposite silk edge taut and flat, while a third minifigure tries to shoo away a brick tortoise that has settled firmly in the centre of the pack.
